parallel.rs ready (INTEL-5): crates/core/src/parallel.rs + 'pub mod parallel;' in lib.rs. API: pub struct FileJob { pub path: String } (FileJob::new(impl Into<String>)); pub fn effective_workers(items: usize, workers: usize) -> usize (0 => min(items, available_parallelism), clamped 1..=max(items,1)); pub fn map_files<T: Send>(items: &[FileJob], workers: usize, f: impl Fn(&FileJob) -> T + Sync) -> Vec<T>. std::thread::scope only (no rayon/tokio). Output sorted by path (ties by input position) => byte-identical for any worker count and repeated runs; workers=1 == sequential. learn() integration: jobs=needs.iter().map(|f| FileJob::new(&f.path)); then map_files(&jobs,0,|job| { let mut a=Analysis::new(); if let Some(lang)=Lang::from_walk(<lang of job.path>) { let src=std::fs::read_to_string(root.join(&job.path))?; analyze(&job.path,lang,&src,symbols_by_file.get(&job.path).map(Vec::as_slice).unwrap_or(&[]),&mut a); } a }); then append parts (path order) into seeded analysis. Determinism proven by test two_runs_and_every_worker_count_are_byte_identical (workers 1/2/8/0 equal). Measured on this repo: files=105 symbols=1355 workers=4 seq=4.006s par=1.785s = 2.24x. Panics in f propagate after scoped threads join.

rules.rs landed for health-v2 (F15). Surface repowalk_core::rules::check(&index,&analysis,&repowalk_core::rules::load(root)) -> Vec<Finding>. Finding{rule, severity, file, line, message}; Severity{Error,Warning} both derive Serialize/Deserialize/Ord (Error<Warning), so findings JSON-encode directly and are pre-sorted by (severity,file,line,rule) — no client re-sort needed. Error = architectural (forbid_imports, no_cycles); Warning = thresholds (max_cyclomatic, max_file_loc). file is repo-relative, line is 1-based (0 for imports/cycles/file-LOC where no line exists). Sample rules.json at repo root: forbid core->gui + gui->cli, max_cyclomatic 50, max_file_loc 5000, no_cycles crates/**. Self-run over this repo: 0 findings.

rules.rs landed. API: repowalk_core::rules::{load,check,Rules,Finding,Severity,glob_match}. Rules{forbid_imports:Vec<(String,String)>, max_cyclomatic:Option<u32>, max_file_loc:Option<usize>, no_cycles:Vec<String>} (Deserialize, serde(default) tolerant). load(root:&Path)->Rules: reads <root>/.repowalk/rules.json, falls back to <root>/rules.json (committed sample), empty rules on missing/unreadable/corrupt. check(index:&Index, analysis:&Analysis, rules:&Rules)->Vec<Finding>, sorted by (severity,file,line,rule). Finding{rule:String, severity:Severity, file:String, line:usize, message:String}; Severity is Error|Warning (Error sorts first). Error = forbid_imports + no_cycles; Warning = max_cyclomatic + max_file_loc. For report exit code: nonzero iff any finding has Severity::Error. NOTE: import findings carry line=0 (Import has no line field); cycles/LOC also line 0. Repo sample passes with 0 findings (self-run: 326 files/1060 cfgs/0 findings).
